architecture.deployment_scope: add a positive scaled version only to the ephemeral virtual-logit suffix; real-key logits and mask bytes stay exact

architecture.name: explicit_routed_virtual_kv

candidate_bank.distractors: Take the minimum source index from the first two lexicographically sorted retrieval donor pairs other than the target/donor pair.
candidate_bank.layer_permutation: For each anchor, score the target query against the target address rolled forward by one over the complete ordered 42-module axis before applying the anchor's frozen map.
candidate_bank.zero_probe: Replace the candidate address with an exact all-zero 64-vector; mapped direction and raw bias must be exact zero, and slot eligibility must be false.
